strategy.note: basis: Tab. 27.5 'Input / Output and uncertainty for the process “copper oxide, at plant (RER)”', column 'copper oxide, at plant' [RER], per 1 kg. Tab. 27.4 on the preceding page gives the same figures per kg copper(II)oxide.; allocation: none; ammonium and carbon dioxide by-products are recovered and returned to the start of the process, so they are not treated as co-products. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: Oxygen (201.131 g stoechiometric) is taken from air and deliberately not inventoried.
Solid wastes were explicitly neglected in this inventory.
No emissions to water: the remaining ammonia compounds are assumed recovered, so the report reports none.
No process emissions to air were measured; the two air emissions are a 0.2 % of stoechiometric input assumption.
skipped_items: copper oxide, at plant: product — the reference product

Ammonium carbonate: no flow chosen (No ammonium carbonate flow exists among the candidates. Every offered flow is a different ammonium salt (acetate, bromide, nitrate, oxalate, sulfate, chloride, fluoride) or the bare ammonium ion, and mapping a carbonate onto one of those would be a different chemical, so the line is reported as missing.)
